title: PgcQuake
description: A mod that adds commands to shake the player's screen.
body:
# PGC Quake

A lightweight Minecraft mod that lets operators shake players' camera screens on demand — perfect for earthquakes, explosions, boss fights, or any dramatic event in your server.

---

## Features

- Shake any player's screen with customizable intensity and duration
- Stop the shake effect instantly at any time
- Smooth camera motion with horizontal and vertical shake
- Fully server-side command control
- Compatible with **Fabric** and **Forge** (via Sinytra Connector)

---

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/quake <player> [intensity] [duration]` | Shake a player's screen |
| `/calm [player]` | Stop the shake effect |

- **intensity** — Shake strength (default: `1.0`, higher = stronger)
- **duration** — Duration in seconds (default: `3`)
